subject: Vendor Swap — Comparative Economics & Integration Risk
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Qureshi <samira@astracloud.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor Swap — Comparative Economics & Integration Risk

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised I pulled together a short comparative package to make switching to Redwood as low-friction as possible. I attached two artifacts: integration-risk-matrix.xlsx (high-level systems and API compatibility) and migration-econ-scenarios.pdf (three-statement TCO scenarios).

High level proposal (summary):
- Competitive first-year pricing that matches your effective per-token run-rate when including current caching + discounts.
- A 90-day pilot credit (up to $75k) + waived onboarding fees to cover engineering ramp and integration validation.
- Commitment to provide a dedicated onboarding engineer for the pilot and a single point of contact for infra questions.
- Optional reserved capacity credits if you choose a Dedicated instance by the end of the pilot.

Two asks from your side to make the analysis concrete:
1) Can you share an anonymized month (or representative week) of traffic and typical sequence lengths (or a sample of prompts)?
2) Procurement timeline and any non‑standard T&Cs we should be aware of (data residency, indemnity caps, export controls).

If it helps, we can propose explicit credit tiers (pilot/commitment/onboarding) and a short checklist for the migration cutover. Would you be available for a 30‑minute alignment call on Tuesday (Oct 5) or Wednesday (Oct 6)?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs: integration-risk-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), migration-econ-scenarios.pdf (PDF)

From: Samira Qureshi <samira@astracloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@astracloud.com
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor Swap — Comparative Economics & Integration Risk

Jonas —

Appreciate the summary and the artifacts. A few quick notes from procurement & infra:

- Procurement wants an explicit line-item breakdown of the credits (pilot cap, onboarding waiver, any committed discount tiers) and the renewal pricing after the first year.
- We will need an initial SLO commitment for latency (p95 under 500ms for inference under the pilot profile) plus a published incident escalation path.
- Data residency: Astro keeps customer data in us‑west only; we need confirmation that any logs/audit trails remain in the same region for the pilot and any dedicated instances.
- Legal: put any indemnity/exclusion language up front; we need to understand if Redwood requires reciprocal clauses or specific liability caps.

Procurement is at: procurement@astracloud.com — I'd like to bring them onto a quick call. Can you do Wednesday Oct 6 at 11:00 PT? Also include a brief tech checklist for our infra team (IP allowlist, auth methods, typical endpoints).

Thanks,
Samira Qureshi
Head of Platform Engineering
AstraCloud
samira@astracloud.com

P.S. We also have an internal cost-savings threshold: switching needs to demonstrate >15% per-unit savings or equivalent performance gains to justify migration effort.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Samira — procurement asks / draft concession plan

Jonas — forwarding Samira's note. Quick internal plan and recommended concessions so we move fast on Wed's call: 

1) Pilot credit structure (recommended):
   - 90-day pilot credit: $60k base, plus up to $15k of onboarding hours (engineering support) billed as credit if used.
   - Onboarding waiver: waive the $8k integration setup fee for pilots that convert to a Dedicated reservation within 120 days.

2) Pricing / renewal anchor:
   - Offer to match AstraCloud's effective blended per-token run-rate for year 1, with a 10% reversion discount cap in year 2 (i.e., price floor to prevent >10% increase).

3) SLOs & region:
   - Commit to p95 < 500ms for pilot profile in us-west region; include a 30-minute pager escalation path for Sev1 and a dedicated Slack channel.

4) Legal & liability:
   - We can accept a reciprocal liability cap tied to fees paid in prior 12 months; ask legal for standard language. No unusual indemnity asked.

5) Tech checklist to prep for call (we should email to Samira before Wed):
   - Provide IP allowlist CIDR ranges, API auth options (API key, mTLS), example cURL and SDK snippets, expected DNS names/endpoints, KV/cache warm-start notes.

Attachments: I updated migration-econ-scenarios.pdf with a conversion table that shows the break-even points at 12/24/36 months. Also created a lightweight integration-risk-matrix.xlsx that maps their services to our endpoints.

Action items: Jonas — I recommend you lead the Wed call, bring Karthik for the infra deep-dive and loop Grace if pricing authority is needed. If procurement pushes for a larger credit ask, we can escalate to a 6-month onboarding credit but prefer to use a mix of credits + reserved capacity incentives.

On Wed we should have an explicit doc/slide we can leave with them that lists the offer and next steps (pilot start date, acceptance criteria, sign-off owner).

-Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Samira / Procurement team —

Thanks for the call today. Per our conversation, here's the formal offer and next steps. I've attached the final integration-risk-matrix.xlsx and migration-econ-scenarios.pdf referenced in the call.

Offer summary (one page):
- Pilot: 90-day pilot starting on confirmed go-live date; $60k usage credit + $15k onboarding credit (covers dedicated onboarding engineer time).
- Onboarding: $8k setup fee waived if AstraCloud converts to a Dedicated reservation at or above the pilot throughput within 120 days.
- Pricing: Match AstraCloud's current blended per-token effective run-rate for year 1 (documented in the attached econ PDF). Year 2 increase capped at +10% from the matched baseline.
- SLOs: p95 < 500ms for pilot traffic profile in us-west region; 30-minute sev1 pager and dedicated Slack channel for the duration of the pilot.
- Legal: Redwood is willing to accept a liability cap tied to 12 months of fees paid; we'll provide standard reciprocal language for review.

Next steps / acceptance checklist:
1) Procurement confirms acceptance of pilot credit structure and legal baseline by 10/8 EOD PT.
2) AstraCloud to provide representative traffic sample and a contact for infra onboarding.
3) Redwood to provide IP allowlist, example SDK snippets, and a pre-configured sandbox account (access within 24–48 hours of acceptance).
4) Once accepted, we circulate a short DocuSign for the pilot addendum and schedule the onboarding kickoff.

DocuSign & links:
- Proposal & pilot addendum (DocuSign): https://docusign.com/prepare/AST-459-offer
- Shared drive (integration artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-integration-matrix
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/AST-459

Samira — if that aligns, please confirm and we'll send the DocuSign and sandbox access later today. Happy to jump on any follow-ups.

Best,
